Horrible experience with these people. My girlfriend needed to have a small childhood accident on the bottom of her nose fixed.
Everything seemed fine when we went into the clinic to discuss the procedure with the doctor. However the first surgery did not go so well and they managed to convince us to attempt a second surgery with them.
The second attempt was just as bad as the first attempt. Their prices were much more expensive than other clinics. But we still decided to go with them because they seemed competent during the discussions process. Another point is that we were surprised to have to spend over 5,000 baht on medicines that were NOT included in the original quoted price.
Today a little over a year later my girlfriend has attempted laser procedures to fix the awful surgery these people performed and multiple other remedies.
Im motivated to warn others of our experience because it now seems she will have to start over and do the surgery again with another clinic to finally fix what these people could not.
So in summary dont waste your pain, time and money like we did.
For reference, the photos show how simple and easy the fix required is. Just remove a section of scare tissue from below the nose and make it look natural. However these photos are from AFTER the surgery they completed.
